## Line 128

```plato

// A superellipse (Lame curve) region: |x/a|^Exponent + |y/b|^Exponent <= 1 in
// the frame rotated by Rotation about Center, with SemiAxes (a, b). Exponent 2
// is the ellipse, 1 the diamond, large values approach the rectangle; convex
// when Exponent >= 1. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Superellipse)
type SuperEllipse
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentered2D, IContainsPoint2D
{
    Center: Point2D;
    SemiAxes: Number2;
    Rotation: Angle;
    Exponent: Number;
}
```
